profile.Name: Stubs Momuso
profile.Personality: Aggressive, touchy, and quick to pick a fight. He admits he gets "major rage" and sometimes talks himself down. He bristles when anyone points out his mangled words.
profile.Backstory: A Scorchlander sellsword found in Shark or Mud Town in the Swamp.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Opens with "You eyeballin' me?!" and calls people "fruitnut". Mangles words like "interromagation" and snaps when corrected.
